title: REQ · Temporary-asset replacement requirements are documented without production claims
summary: A document lists how each temporary asset must be replaced
description: Context: game/frontend/public/assets/README.md exists but does not list per-layer replacement requirements. Desired behavior: a new document game/docs/temporary-assets.md lists every asset group, required dimensions, frame counts and formats for replacements, and states the assets are temporary and not production-quality. Why: honesty and future replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Given the document, when read, then it has a section for backgrounds, furniture, objects, characters and effects
Given the document, when searched, then it contains the word temporary and states the assets are not production-quality
Given the document, when searched, then it names every manifest id of the new assets
